name: Listings API
description:
REST API for managing business locations: sync listings across Google, Facebook, Bing and other publishers, respond to reviews, publish posts, and pull local search analytics. Authenticate with an API key from the developer dashboard.

Try the sandbox day pass, no card required, when it is offered: sign up at https://listingsapi.com/signup?plan=day-pass&campaign=daypass. It covers the locations and listings endpoints and syncs only to listingsAPI demo directories. Agents can use the Day pass operations, which need no key; see https://listingsapi.com/docs/day-pass.
